categories.title: Health Facilities
categories.subtitle: Quezon City Hospitals, Super Health Centers, & Barangay Health Centers

legend.label: Health Facilities
legend.description: Tertiary hospitals, Super Health Centers, Barangay Health Centers

dengue_relevance.clinical_significance: Essential sites for early Dengue NS1 antigen rapid diagnostic testing, CBC/platelet monitoring, oral rehydration therapy (ORT), and inpatient referral.
dengue_relevance.flood_compound_risk: CDRA 2022 Section 3.7.3 identifies 12 health centers and 13 hospitals in areas subject to >0.5m flood depth during severe storms (e.g., Brgys Sienna, West Triangle, Milagrosa, Central, Damayang Lagi, Doña Imelda). Compounded monsoon flooding risks cutting off critical healthcare triage during dengue outbreaks.

categories.title: Public Schools
categories.subtitle: Quezon City Public Elementary & High Schools

dengue_relevance.clinical_significance: Quezon City eLLCAP 2021-2050 (pp. 33-35) highlights that children under 15 comprise 30% of the city population and suffer the highest morbidity from dengue shock syndrome.
dengue_relevance.diurnal_exposure: Aedes aegypti mosquitoes are daytime biters with peak feeding between 6:00-9:00 AM and 3:00-6:00 PM, exactly coinciding with school class hours and outdoor play.

categories.title: Child Development Centers
categories.subtitle: Quezon City Barangay Day Care & Early Childhood Centers

legend.label: Child Development Centers
legend.description: Barangay early childhood care and development centers

dengue_relevance.clinical_significance: Toddlers and infants have underdeveloped immune systems, presenting the greatest risk of rapid dehydration and severe capillary leakage when infected with dengue.
dengue_relevance.environmental_focus: Requires rigorous daily search-and-destroy of artificial container breeding sites in center courtyards, toy bins, and plant saucers.

categories.title: Higher Education Institutions
categories.subtitle: State Universities, Colleges, & Higher Ed Campuses

dengue_relevance.role: High Daytime Foot Traffic & Expansive Campus Grounds
dengue_relevance.clinical_significance: Vast green spaces and campus waterways (such as UP Diliman and Ateneo grounds) require proactive vector control and drainage maintenance.

dengue_relevance.clinical_significance: Staging hubs for water dewatering in flooded barangays and mobile misting/fogging operations during post-flood dengue outbreaks.
